### Cash-Secured Put — Entry Conditions: 🟢 4/4 GOOD SETUP

- ✅ Daily RSI 13.5 ≤ 40 — deeply oversold
- ✅ Price $277.59 near 52W low $270.70 (2.5% above)
- ✅ Premium yield: $265 put at 1.83%, $280 put at 3.82%

**Strike Analysis:**

| $250 | $1.99 | 0.80% | $248.01 | 652 |
| $280 (ATM) | $10.70 | 3.82% | $269.30 | 724 |

**Recommended: $265 strike** — below 52W low, excellent yield, cost basis represents 35.6% discount from high. Expiry: 2026-12-04.

### Covered Call — Entry Conditions: 🟡 2/4 MARGINAL

- ❌ RSI 13.5 — deeply oversold, don't cap recovery upside
- ❌ Weekly RSI 15.5 — deeply oversold on weekly
- ✅ $305 call yields 0.82%

**Verdict: WAIT.** Do not sell calls into deep oversold conditions. Wait for RSI 60+ bounce.

### LEAPS Monitor — Score: 4/6 🟢 (with caveats)
- ✅ Daily RSI 13.5 ≤ 35
- ❌ Weekly RSI 15.5 still falling (prev 36.6)
- ✅ Price within 5% of 52W low support
- ❌ IV Rank 93.0 — extremely expensive to buy options
- ✅ LEAPS $305C spread 8.2%, OI 197
- ✅ Pullback 31.3% ≥ 15%

**Caution:** IV Rank 93 means LEAPs are prohibitively expensive. Sell premium (CSP) rather than buy it. Wait for IV crush before considering LEAPs.
